t: This is Lowther Lodge, a house in South Kensington just south of Hyde Park. It has been the headquarters of the Royal Geographical Society since 1912. The architect was Richard Norman Shaw, a Royal Academician who worked from the 1870s to the 1900s. He is considered among the greatest British architects, and was known for his country houses and commercial buildings. His influence on architectural style was strongest in the 1880s and 1890s.
